phase2.label: attempt 2, retrained at 256 after M43's attempt-1 numbers were seen
phase2.recipe: M43's RECIPE with only max_length changed to 256: the same queries, teacher logits (scored at 512), lists, loss, schedule, epochs, selection rule and seed 0; M43's RECIPE constant is not edited
phase2.cost_source: cost of the same-architecture attempt-1 row: the attempt-1 student's CPU row (same architecture, tokenizer and cap)
phase2.not_gating: Phase 2 runs after the headline commit; if it does not finish, the report says so and the core stands
phase2.device_note: attempt 1 trained on A40s; a Phase-2 student trained on another device is a second stated difference, recorded in the manifest
phase2.rows: the parent, the attempt-1 students and their inits at depth 5/10/20 x max_length 256 (the anchors: they must equal M51's committed shapes files), and the two attempt-2 students at the same shapes

anchor.rows: M43's committed rows, which this run must reproduce

bar.name: M51: the cheaper shapes
bar.question: is there ANY shape that beats no reranker on all three datasets (fixture v1's held-out half, BEIR SciFact, BEIR FiQA) and is under the indicative HPC-CPU budget?
bar.headline: the F1 answer; F2's answer is reported beside it and never modifies it; an over-budget cell never answers the question
bar.passes: a cell wins on all three datasets: fixture v1's held-out half, BEIR SciFact and BEIR FiQA (an intersection: no adjustment across datasets)
bar.verdict: on the stored 4-decimal bounds, as M43's bar_table: win if lo > 0, loss if hi < 0, tie otherwise
bar.families: each family controls its own family-wise error at 5%; the families are not jointly controlled
bar.against_the_served_shape: descriptive only (no adjustment; it does not enter the answer): each cell's paired delta against the same tag's 20/512 row at 95%; above zero the cheaper shape is better, below zero a measured quality cost, covering zero no measured difference, which is NOT equivalence
bar.also_reported: each student against its init at the same shape; per row the reranked pairs the cap truncated and loaded_max_length read back; the GPU rerank latency (this run's device, not the server; recorded at run time, not re-scored)
bar.sensitivity: descriptive, from the sidecars on a CPU, never changing an answer: per F1 cell and dataset a paired sign-flip permutation p-value for the nDCG@10 delta (20,000 sign draws, seed 0); per student cell in F1 or F2 its SciFact and FiQA deltas re-read on the test queries with no relevant document among the students' synthetic source documents (the exposure file)
bar.not_decided_here: the serving bar: added p95 latency and peak memory on the host itself (scripts/time_reranker_on_host.py), unrun
bar.frozen: the grid, models, bands, families, adjusted levels, answer levels and their order, the replicate arm and Phase 2, at the declarations commit, before any job that scores a test query; a later change is a second reading recorded beside the first, never a replacement

verdict.interval: the paired nDCG@10 delta against hybrid@bge-small per dataset: a percentile bootstrap over queries, 2000 resamples, seed 0, 95% (app/eval/stats.py defaults, np.percentile linear interpolation; one index matrix per file and scope, shared by every row)
verdict.rule: on the stored 4-decimal bounds, as M43's bar_table: win if lo > 0, loss if hi < 0, tie otherwise
verdict.passes_on_quality: a cell wins on all three datasets: fixture v1's held-out half, BEIR SciFact and BEIR FiQA (an intersection: no adjustment across datasets)

F1.about: the headline: the shapes under the indicative HPC-CPU budget

F2.about: reported beside F1 and never modifying it: an F2 YES with an F1 non-YES says only that a borderline cell qualifies

F3.about: Phase 2 only (attempt 2): the retrained students' cells whose attempt-1 twin is under-indicative-budget; its own answer, never merged into F1 or F2

small_rerankers.family_control: each family controls its own family-wise error at 5%; the families are not jointly controlled
answer_levels: PASSES PER CELL, NOT AFTER ADJUSTMENT

adjusted.matrix: its own index matrix per dataset (fixture: drawn over the 68 held-out queries)
adjusted.rounding: 4 decimals; read with the same rule (lo > 0 on the stored value)

bands.inputs: p95 = shapes[depth = d].p95_ms and peak = that shape's memory_mib.VmHWM of the small_rerankers_cpu.json entry with this tag and max_length = m, joined on (tag, max_length, shapes[].depth), never on the entry's config string (it says fp32-512/top20 even on the 256 entries); L = api_memory_mib's default in infra/modules/single-host/variables.tf
bands.under-indicative-budget: p95 <= 1000 ms AND peak <= 0.9 L (at least 10% memory headroom)
bands.borderline: not under-indicative-budget, p95 <= 2500 ms AND peak <= L
bands.what_a_band_is: an indicative budget on one HPC CPU (Xeon Silver 4114, 2 torch threads, the torch 2.5.1+cu121 wheel), NOT a host budget: the t3.small host may be more than twice as slow, and no band says a shape fits the host

device_rule.result: RTX 2080 Ti (Slurm -p eecs --constraint=rtx2080), the device of every row of M43's three files
device_rule.fallback: only after a recorded 24 h wait: all three datasets together on -p gpu --constraint=rtx8000; A40 only if both are blocked for a further 24 h, again all three, recorded
device_rule.other_device: a row computed on any device other than the result's is a labelled replicate, never the result

small_rerankers.run_time_only: the GPU rerank latency (this run's device, not the server) and the per-query rank hashes themselves (the full rankings are not committed): recorded at run time, not re-scored; every aggregate and invariant derived from the hashes is re-scored
small_rerankers.load_and_score: every (model, cap) first ranks the check's answer above an unrelated passage with the loaded instance, and its loaded_max_length reads back as the cap, or the run stops (app/eval/models_2026.py)

reproduces.compared: every field of each row's retrieval block (rounded means; by category on the fixture), [committed, this run] where they differ

does_not_show: host timing or memory: the serving bar, unrun (scripts/time_reranker_on_host.py)
students' quality on an unseen corpus: they read 1,500 SciFact and 1,800 FiQA documents (never a test query or label; see the exposure file)
the publishers' training data overlap with BEIR test sets: not audited for any model
equivalence: a delta against 20/512 that covers zero is no measured difference, not the same quality
answer quality: no LLM answer is generated or judged

the GPU rerank latency (this run's device, not the server) and the per-query rank hashes themselves (the full rankings are not committed): recorded at run time, not re-scored; every aggregate and invariant derived from the hashes is re-scored
the attempt-2 students are one training run each (seed 0), retrained after M43's attempt-1 numbers were seen; their cost is the same-architecture attempt-1 row's (not timed again)
the training corpora: like attempt 1, they read every fixture chunk and 1,500 SciFact and 1,800 FiQA documents (never a test query or label)
